title: Make deploy.sh fail-safe
prompt:
deploy.sh is unreliable. Fix it.

Required behaviour:
- Usage: ./deploy.sh --env <name> --tag <tag>
- Unknown arguments, missing values, or a missing --env/--tag must print a
  message to stderr and exit 2.
- The script must exit non-zero as soon as any command fails.
- Referencing an unset variable must be an error, not an empty string.
- It writes the line "deploy <env> <tag>" to deploy.log in the current
  directory, then prints "deployed <env> <tag>" to stdout.
- It must work when the checkout path contains spaces.

Only deploy.sh should change.
